title: A Good Friend
text:
Maria and Ali have been friends since they were children. They live on the same street, so they often walk to school together. Ali is very kind, and he always helps Maria when she has a problem. Maria likes to listen to his stories about football.

Last year, Maria moved to another city for her job. At first, they missed each other a lot. However, they call each other every Sunday, and they still talk about their favorite films. Maria says their friendship is strong, even when they are far apart.

questions.text: How long have Maria and Ali been friends?
options: Since they moved to a new city

questions.text: Why did Maria move to another city?
How does Ali probably feel about Maria?
options: He does not like her stories

questions.text: What can we infer about Maria and Ali's friendship?
options: It has ended because of the distance
It is still strong despite the distance
It depends only on going to the same school
They never talk to each other now

vocabulary.definition: friendly and caring about other people
a difficult situation that needs to be solved

paragraph_translations: Maria ile Ali çocukluklarından beri arkadaştır. Aynı sokakta yaşadıkları için genellikle okula birlikte yürürler. Ali çok naziktir ve Maria'nın bir sorunu olduğunda her zaman ona yardım eder. Maria, Ali'nin futbol hakkındaki hikayelerini dinlemeyi sever.

Geçen yıl Maria işi için başka bir şehre taşındı. Başta birbirlerini çok özlediler. Yine de her Pazar birbirlerini arıyorlar ve hâlâ en sevdikleri filmler hakkında konuşuyorlar. Maria, uzakta olsalar bile arkadaşlıklarının güçlü olduğunu söylüyor.
